review: Recovered Alpha runtime isolation and gaps
mode: read-only static source review; no application/native execution

sections.finding: Configure private Electron paths before importing recovered main: top-level code already constructs userData stores and requests the single-instance lock. Keep app.isPackaged false.
sections.caveat: Electron path overrides are not an OS filesystem sandbox. Native code may resolve user directories through other APIs. Use process-level filesystem/network restrictions; do not alter the user shell global environment.

sections.finding: Original development paths assume a monorepo: app.getAppPath()/../.. is workspace, then target/debug, build/runtime-bundle and workers/agent/dist are used. Running electron at the recovered project root resolves the wrong workspace.
sections.minimum_adaptation: Use an apps/desktop app directory or introduce explicit recovered project/runtime roots in the adapter. Do not spoof packaged mode.

sections.finding: Development mode supports absolute engine and worker paths. Preserve the full original runtime relative layout and original hashes/policies.
notes: writerBundleRoot and voice-model catalog paths also need vendor/runtime mapping.
ALPHA_AGENT_HOST_NODE must be the real Electron executable. Set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE only for appropriate child processes, never in the environment launching the GUI Electron process.
The packaged child environment sets ALPHA_WORKER_SUPERVISOR=0, ALPHA_MESSAGE_ROUTING=1 and ALPHA_BIZ_ROUTING=1; if adapting the runtime helper, preserve normal routing semantics and all verification.

sections.finding: Runtime ALPHA_DATA_DIR is Electron userData. Artifacts, media cache, transcription cache, snapshots and vault default below that root. Startup enforces snapshot/vault/key confinement.
sections.minimum_adaptation: Start with a fresh private userData, no imported accounts/keys/vault. Remove inherited ALPHA_* credentials and paths and rebuild a minimal allowlisted environment. In particular do not inherit ALPHA_ACCOUNT_REGISTRY_PATH.

sections.finding: Development update configuration reads ALPHA_UPDATE_* only. With none configured, update state is unconfigured and refresh returns without a network request. Startup and a 15-minute timer still invoke refresh.
sections.minimum_adaptation: Keep development mode and clear ALPHA_UPDATE_ROOT_PUBLIC_KEY_BASE64URL, ALPHA_UPDATE_POLICY_URL, ALPHA_UPDATE_POLICY_PATH and ALPHA_UPDATE_MIRROR_BASE_URL. Do not remove signature validation or turn blocked/forced into ready. Network restrictions must cover native sidecars as well as Electron sessions.

sections.finding: Startup calls observeRestoredLicense -> engine.getCapabilities before the final reconcileEngineGate -> engine.start. Therefore isolation must be in place before importing main, not merely before showing the window.
fresh_defaults: HTTP API disabled; push disabled; LAN disabled
macOS development build does not support login-item registration
sections.minimum_adaptation: Use fresh state and do not trigger sign-in, model downloads, connection enabling or sending. Verify real engine status and an empty registered-account list separately from UI visibility.

evidence.snippet: config = { enabled: false, port: 5031, pushEnabled: false, lan: false };

sections.finding: listAccounts reads registered accounts. discoverAccounts requires a source location. detectAccountDataSources separately probes Electron home/documents/appData, so changing userData alone is insufficient.
sections.minimum_adaptation: Restrict smoke tests to status/listAccounts. In the safe launch adapter, reject real account discovery, directory selection, key acquisition/import, sending and database mutation IPC with an explicit sandbox-unavailable error. Never fake successful backend responses.

sections.finding: JavaScript startup checks existence of engine/security-host/data-host, then performs a protobuf hello. Native policy and peer image verification may still reject a copied runtime.
sections.minimum_adaptation: Keep peer-manifest, trust policies, dates, signatures and binaries intact. Preserve RUNTIME_PEER_*, SECURITY_HOST_* and SECURITY_RUNTIME_POLICY_REJECTED failures; do not bypass verification or report backend-ready on failure.

findings: Native children inherit the sandbox; this covers Rust sidecar outbound networking unlike Electron session webRequest filtering.
The profile intentionally allows normal system framework access, while denying user-home reads/writes except project reads and .runtime writes.
Do not add broad Library, Library/Containers, Library/Group Containers, Application Support or Keychains read exceptions. Those can expose real app/account data.
If Electron needs user fonts/preferences, identify a specific benign path from a concrete denial and grant only that exact path or subdirectory. First try the profile without user-Library exceptions.
Launch the sandboxed Electron executable directly; avoid running npm or a login shell inside it, since tools/config under the real user home are intentionally denied.
Home path overrides and outbound denial do not themselves establish complete UI/native compatibility. Capture actual logs and report restrictions that prevent startup.
macos_sandbox_recommendation.remaining_caveat: The allow-default base does not restrict writes outside the real user-home tree. Bootstrap should redirect app temp/state paths; stricter global write controls need compatibility testing.

observed_smoke_result.ui: main renderer loaded; no renderer errors

confirmed_adaptation_errors.finding: readBoundedFile rejects any symlink ancestor, so build/runtime-bundle symlink necessarily failed WCDB writer validation.
confirmed_adaptation_errors.status: Parent reported fixed by a full byte-preserving copy.

confirmed_adaptation_errors.finding: ALPHA_ENABLE_LOCAL_MESSAGE_RETENTION is not a recognized flag. Actual retention flags are ALPHA_ENABLE_MOMENTS_ANTI_DELETE and ALPHA_ENABLE_MESSAGE_ANTI_RECALL, and valid bundle discovery otherwise defaults them on.
confirmed_adaptation_errors.status: Parent reported both actual flags now explicitly zero.

confirmed_adaptation_errors.finding: process.execPath in the external Node launcher points outside project; the sandbox denies that home-tree executable. This is not the cause of current AI-off startup failure.
confirmed_adaptation_errors.recommendation: Use the project Electron executable for the worker, with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE only in its child environment.

confirmed_adaptation_errors.finding: PersonaGateway resolvePaths ignores ALPHA_AGENT_HOST_PATH and uses workspace/workers/agent/dist/index.cjs in development. That path was absent during review.
confirmed_adaptation_errors.recommendation: Build/copy recovered worker to the expected path or add a narrowly scoped explicit runtime-root adapter. AI-off UI testing does not cover this path.

confirmed: Security-host is present and bytes were verified against the copied bundle by parent provenance.
codesign --verify --strict --verbose=2 vendor/runtime/bin/alpha-security-host reports valid on disk and satisfies Designated Requirement.
The guard policy is embedded in the binary; static strings show alpha.runtime-policy.v2, alpha.guard.macho64.v1 and APOL-BIND-v1.
Observed native error is INTEGRITY, not EXPIRED.
integrity_failure_scope.candidate_not_yet_proven: Electron app.setPath(home) does not rewrite the inherited HOME environment. Native strings show HOME plus Library/Application Support/Alpha/RuntimeState and runtime-peer storage paths, so native state may resolve outside the isolated app paths and be denied. Configure only the launched process environment for a private home/temp root and retain OS denial of the real home; do not modify shell globals.
not_found_in_static_scan: No explicit ALPHA_RUNTIME_POLICY_PATH, ALPHA_RUNTIME_POLICY_FILE or ALPHA_GUARD override was found.
do_not_conclude: A valid macOS code signature does not prove the separate custom guard accepts the runtime.
Static path strings alone do not prove the exact failing guard branch.
Do not attribute the current failure to expiry or patch policies/signatures to force success.

sandbox_note.current_profile_difference: deny file-read-data preserves metadata traversal required for Chromium; explicit project data access is allowed. Remote IP outbound is denied; loopback is allowed for Playwright/Electron.
sandbox_note.chromium_sandbox: The launch uses --no-sandbox because nested Chromium sandbox initialization fails under the outer Seatbelt profile. Document that only the outer application/process sandbox is active; do not claim Chromium renderer sandbox is also active.
sandbox_note.scope: No target binary executed by this reviewer. No signature, policy, license, source or script modification.
